class.name: CbImpulse
class.brief_description: A change of velocity, once, when its motion starts. A dash, a double jump, a shove.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion]. On the tick the motion starts (with a [CbProbe]: the tick the probe takes hold), the target's velocity changes by [member speed] along the effect's direction, whatever it weighs. On a prop it is applied at the point the probe holds, so it spins. It happens once. For a push that lasts, use a [CbForce].

members.member: The change of velocity, in metres per second. Up to 200.
What of the target's velocity is cleared before the impulse is added.

constants.constant: The impulse is added to the velocity.
The vertical speed is cleared first: a jump in the air is the same jump however fast the fall was.
The horizontal velocity is cleared first: a dash is the same dash however fast the run was.
The whole velocity is cleared first.
